query: 2026 gubernatorial debates scheduled summer 2026 Pennsylvania Shapiro Garrity, Oregon Kotek Drazan, Arizona Hobbs, Wisconsin - any debate before September 2026
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the summary:

**No general-election gubernatorial debate is scheduled before September 2026 in any of the four states.**

- **Pennsylvania (Shapiro vs. Garrity):** Both willing to debate (first since 2018), but nothing confirmed — no dates, host, or moderator. Garrity called for 7 debates; unresolved as of late June 2026.
- **Oregon (Kotek vs. Drazan):** Kotek proposed three televised debates "starting in September" (June 11); she declined an earlier newspaper-group debate (June 18), citing a busy summer. Earliest is September — nothing before.
- **Arizona (Hobbs vs. TBD):** GOP primary is July 21, so no general-election opponent yet. Hobbs has not committed to any debate. None possible before September.
- **Wisconsin (open seat):** Primary Aug. 11. Confirmed general-election debates are both in October (Oct. 8 TMJ4 town hall; Oct. 9 WBA/Milwaukee PBS). A July 28 WISN 12 debate is a Democratic *primary* debate, not general-election.

The common thread: late-summer primaries (AZ July 21, WI Aug 11) push general-election debates into September–October across the board.
